column1: # Partition table for builds WITH ESP-SR (speech recognition)
# Factory: 4992K  (BLE 4.2 legacy APIs + ~34KB vs prior image; still tight)
# Model:   3008K  Sized for WN9_HIESP (~292K) + MN7_EN_QUANT (~2.6M) +
#          fst (~12K). Packed srmodels.bin is ~2980K — 2944K (the prior
#          size) overflowed by 36K and silent-truncated the WN entry into
#          the next partition
#          NULL and srstart failed with "No wake word model found!". Bumped
#          to 3008K to give ~28K headroom. Chinese MultiNet (~3.5M) is
#          disabled in sdkconfig — a smaller model bundle is what makes
#          everything fit on the 8M chip.
# LittleFS: 128K  (trimmed vs 172K so factory can grow for BLE 4.2 + app;
#          logs/cache; bulk content on SD card.)
# Flash-encryption prep (2026-07-30): nvs moved to 0xA000 and shrunk 24K->16K
# to make room for BOTH a 4K nvs_key partition (XTS keys for NVS encryption
# mandatory in any CONFIG_SECURE_FLASH_ENC_ENABLED build) AND a partition
# table at 0x9000 - the FE-enabled bootloader is ~33K
# 0x8000 table allows
# CONFIG_PARTITION_TABLE_OFFSET=0x9000. Plain boards keep the table at 0x8000
# and simply leave 0x8000-0xA000 slack; the same CSV serves both offsets.
# littlefs (and model
